rows.grounds: compound jagat-ānanda-karī; epithet attributing the production of bliss for the world
compound jagat-āhlāda-kāriṇī; epithet attributing the production of delight for the world

items.question: What beneficent effects upon the world characterize this goddess?
premises: Both epithets attribute world-directed beneficent effects to her.
items.inference: Therefore the goddess is characterized as causing both bliss and delight for the world.
uncertainties: The precise semantic distinction between ānanda and āhlāda is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: And she is the one who brings bliss to the world and causes the world to rejoice.
